claim: Onboarding OB-6, sign-up hand-off, page half (founder /goal 2026-11-07, every fork the session's call; proposal p4-scratch/sw-walk/onboarding/proposal.md §3 OB-6). The key 'mudavym:verification-mail' that AuthContext.registerAccount keeps (row OB-6-SIGN-UP-MAIL-KEPT-FOR-VERIFY-EMAIL, the PR below) is read by /verify-email: it seeds one mailState from it (readSignUpMail) and a resend writes its own answer back to the same key (setMailState then noteSignUpMail), so a reload says the same thing and a newer answer replaces an older one (the #856 fixer commit 75100d9ab replaced the read-once-and-clear of 27a2f7c5c). A verified link clears the key (clearSignUpMail), so the note never returns for this account (audit 2026-11-07). The page says 'not_sent' as an alert beside the resend button, with the 'Open the email' steps hidden, and 'unconfirmed' as a status note, never a 'sent' toast; 'sent' keeps today's words. Split out of #856 on 2026-11-07 to keep each PR under 30K of diff. Behavioural proof: apps/web/src/pages/__tests__/VerifyEmail.signUpMail.test.tsx, which fails against #856's VerifyEmail.tsx.
